items.name: Glow Moth
items.description: A slow lantern moth that will sit on a hand for as long as the hand is still. Prized for the dust it sheds, and Lyra is firm that the ones which shed best are the ones nobody has been admiring.

items.name: Dew Slug
items.description: Placid to the point of comedy, and it feeds on the damp off cold glass. Left alone in a settled habitat it produces a clear slime that steadies a brew better than anything the valley grows.

items.name: Starlight Shard
items.description: A cold splinter that steadies any luminous reaction it is dropped into. The counter in the square has sold them for years and will not say where they come from, and asking twice gets you a shorter answer than asking once.

items.name: Splash Rune
items.description: Turns a potion outward instead of inward — one wide fast release rather than a held one. The mark is cut, not written, and the workshop has a drawer of failed attempts to prove how fine the difference is.

items.name: Echo Rune
items.description: Coils a potion so it happens, pauses, and happens again a little softer. Ione's note says the second pass is the honest one, because it is the effect without any of the brewer's enthusiasm left in it.

items.name: Delay Rune
items.description: Makes a potion wait. Not weaker, not slower once it starts — simply held, until whatever the brewer was afraid of has had time to arrive. The most-copied mark in the workshop's drawer, by a wide margin.

items.name: Kiln Geode
items.description: A quarry geode that never finished cooling. Cracked open it still throws heat, and it drives a reaction hotter than it has any right to.
source_conditions: deep in the quarry cuts, where the stone was worked hardest

items.name: Stillwater Pearl
items.description: Formed in the one part of the shallows the current never reaches. It settles a mixture the way deep water settles silt.
source_conditions: mist or rain, when the surface stops moving
the dead water behind the reed bar

items.name: Bloomwing
items.description: A broad-winged valley pollinator, thought gone until the rows opened all at once and something came back to them.

items.name: Ward Rune
items.description: Turns a potion inward instead of outward, holding its effect on the drinker rather than letting it spend itself on the air. The counter in town has never stocked one.
source_conditions: cut into the workshop benches themselves
prised loose only where the frame has already given up the piece

items.name: Saltroad Amber
items.description: Amber off the coast road, three weeks of carriage from here. It holds a reaction open far longer than anything the valley grows, and no bed, seam or ward in this valley will ever produce one.

items.name: Southmarket Myrrh
items.description: Resin from beyond the pass, sold in pinches and weighed carefully. Rowan has tried four times to grow the tree it comes from and will not discuss it.

items.name: Channel Slag
items.description: Twenty years of imbuing left a glassy crust in the bottom of the channels, and nobody ever swept them because nobody was ever coming back. It holds a reaction open the way the bench holds heat: not fiercely, just for longer than seems reasonable.
source_conditions: autumn and winter, when the cold makes the residual glow visible
evening and night, when the residual glow makes it findable at all
the low end of a channel run, where the melt collected before it cooled

items.name: Dustwake Shrimp
items.description: Thumbnail-sized and nearly transparent, hatched out of floor dust that has been bone dry for years. The eggs wait out every drought the quarry has and back the sump to fill again, which Brin says is the only opinion on this site he has never known to be wrong.
source_conditions: the quarry sump, in the hours after it fills
gone again by the time the floor dries

items.name: Shelf Silverfish
items.description: It eats the size out of old bindings and nothing else, so it only lives where a shelf has been left alone. Ione has never had one killed. Where they are thickest is where nobody has looked in twenty years, which she says is the most honest index in the building.
source_conditions: taken from the boards, never from a page

items.name: Counterkept Shard
items.description: Mira keeps a few back under the counter and sells the rest. She has never explained the difference to a customer, and the difference is that these ones were picked. Steadier in a luminous reaction than anything the square will sell you.

items.name: Eleven-Year Amber
items.description: Tarn has carried this since before he took the waystation, through eleven years of watching carts go past the top of the valley without stopping. He is not sentimental about it and says so twice, which is how you know.

items.name: Backshelf Pearl
items.description: It sat twenty years on the shelf Wren kept for the cases she could not fix, because a pearl that settles anything was the nearest thing to use she could find for it. She would rather it went into work now.
